scope: Sold/unsold status measured after current-year sales allocation. Complete 95% of scheduled sold and 50% of scheduled unsold from 2027. Remaining areas re-enter next-year pool; no completed-unsold stock estimated. This is an aggregate approximation, not project-level completion decisions.
fixed: Mortgage nominal, cash area, CPI, price coefficients, launch rule, class rules, profiles, terminal sales unchanged.
caveat: Sensitivity, not empirical delay estimate or selected baseline. Numerical equilibrium does not validate price coefficients.
